function.name: set_volume
function.description: Set the global volume for all audio playback. The volume level can be specified as an integer value ranging from 0 (mute) to 100 (maximum volume). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume level to be set for audio playback. Valid range is from 0 to 100, where 0 is completely muted and 100 is the highest volume.

function.name: play_song
function.description: Plays the requested song based on the provided search query. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search query for the song, such as the song's title or artist's name.

volume.description: The volume level to play the song at, ranging from 0 (mute) to 100 (maximum volume).

shuffle.description: Whether to shuffle the playback when multiple songs match the query.
